headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 29, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 13.77%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 8.96%. This results in an average alpha of 4.82%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 42.06%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', returned 4.47%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. The ability to outperform SPY during this period highlights the portfolio's resilience amidst potential market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
